title: Rightward scan transformation
statement: Let $B$ and $\Gamma$ be types, let $g:\Gamma\to B$ and $s:\Gamma\to B\to\Gamma$ be functions, let $b_0\in B$, and let $w$ be a finite word over $\Gamma$. A scan that, at each symbol, replaces it by the previous state and sets the state to the symbol’s $g$-value, followed by a scan that leaves the state and symbols unchanged, returns the state $(g(w))_{\mathrm{last}}$ if $w$ is nonempty and $b_0$ otherwise, together with the word obtained by pairing each symbol of $w$ with its corresponding entry in $b_0::(g(w))$ and applying $s$ to each pair.
